anchor_policy: anchors checked and reported, never used to select a case or seed; only explicit anchored policy uses them
baseline_note: conventional_eic is our numeric-only hierarchical one-hot adaptation; not official CBOB/SCBO

comparison_protocol.candidate_generation: common screened global stream; registered RA variants may augment; native LSBO has original search

flight_risk: post-optimization validation only; nominal optimizer is not a chance-constrained physical-risk optimizer
initial_policy: random draws never rejected using feasibility labels; warm/cold reported after evaluation

random.description: Uniform random search over the exact-screened candidate pool

sparsity: ordinary/sparse are prospective task names, actual fractions and binomial intervals must be reported

staged_policy.cold_local_rule: disabled until first usable feasible, unless coverage-only control
staged_policy.coverage_scope: scheduled all phases; singleton gate fallback; exact precheck only
staged_policy.feedback_limitation: current math tasks mainly exact+sign; not a finite-interval test

statistical_claim: smoke/pilot exploratory; confirm is a candidate protocol, not automatic publication evidence

statistical_endpoints.inference: development seeds already inspected; no confirmatory superiority claim

settings.feedback: region violation returns only a sign and skips the objective
